How we work

BUILT FOR ENTERPRISE.

DELAG works directly with enterprise teams to measurably improve how their trained models execute across the stack.

Our solution combines proprietary IP with deep engineering, tailored to the customer’s environment, constraints and performance targets.



BUILT AROUND YOUR ENVIRONMENT.

DELAG works with the stack and hardware you already have, rather than forcing your workload into a predefined platform or vendor ecosystem. We support PyTorch and ONNX natively and target all major silicon manufacturers: Arm, AMD, and Intel. Our approach is flexible and we are able to very quickly support custom setups or non-standard hardware.(edited)

WHERE DELAG

01

REAL-TIME & EDGE

When latency, memory, compute and power budgets define what the product can do.
Robotics · Drones · Computer Vision · Autonomous Systems · Real-time Simulation · Embedded AI

For workloads running close to the sensor, device or control loop, execution efficiency directly affects responsiveness, memory footprint and how much capability the hardware can support. DELAG optimizes the post-training execution path to make better use of the target environment.

Get in touch
02

VOLUME

When small inefficiencies become very large numbers.
High-volume Inference · Recommendation Systems · Ad Serving · Search & Ranking · Large-scale ML Services

At scale, even small reductions in latency, memory use or compute per request can translate into significant infrastructure savings. DELAG improves execution efficiency where workloads run continuously, across large fleets or at very high request volumes.

ENTERPRISE ML EXECUTION

PyTorch · ONNX models · Runtime Replacement · Production Inference · Selected Target Platforms

KEEP THE MODEL. REPLACE THE BOTTLENECK.

WHAT TRIGGERS THE CALL.

PERFORMANCE & LATENCY

Cut execution time where speed is the binding constraint.

MEMORY & FOOTPRINT

Reduce runtime and software overhead where memory is scarce or expensive.

HARDWARE COST

Reach the required performance on cheaper hardware, or create headroom on what is already deployed.

CLOUD ECONOMICS

Reduce compute consumption where small inefficiencies scale into significant operating cost.

PORTABILITY & DEPLOYMENT

Improve how models move across target environments and reduce friction in the path to production.

MORE CAPABILITY

Fit more ML functionality onto the same platform without changing the trained model.

Special Ops

FOR THE CASES
THAT DON’T FIT THE BOX.

Some problems don’t follow the standard path. A constrained chipset. An unusual deployment environment. A stack that has grown too complex. Or simply a use case that doesn’t map neatly to an existing category.

Special Ops is where DELAG brings proprietary IP and deep engineering together around the specific problem in front of us.
